title: The French recordist's tape and the Mills and Larry mix-up
summary: A Frenchman with a tape recorder recorded the band; Thomas tells of a book with errors and of a tape put in the wrong box between Mills and Larry.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
